subject: Next steps: POC trial model grid, fallback, localization & owners
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixcommerce.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Cc: Danielle Price <danielle.price@helixcommerce.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & POC asks (languages: EN, ES, FR)

Hi Mateo / Aditya —

Thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can lock the POC scope: 

- Goal: 80%+ automation for initial customer chat triage (intent detection + basic routing) across EN/ES primary, FR as secondary.
- Volume: ~1.2M incoming messages/month; target trial slice = 25k live-conversation tokens/day for 2 weeks.
- Acceptance: intent classification macro-F1 >= 0.82 on our internal testset; avg user satisfaction (post-chat survey) +10% from baseline; false-positive routing < 5%.

Open questions for your recommended model(s) and fallback strategy:
1) Which open models would you shortlist for EN/ES (and reasonable FR coverage) that balance quality and cost?
2) What fallback would you recommend if the primary candidate has high latency or spikes under load?
3) Any immediate eval assets you need from us (labeled examples, sample convo logs)?
4) Rough timeline and who on your side would own the POC engineering/contact?

We can share a sanitized sample dataset (15k utterances) and the taxonomy for routing. Danielle will own procurement questions in parallel.

Attachments: poc-acceptance-metrics.xlsx (baseline metrics)

Thanks —
Priya Shah
Head of Product, Helix Commerce
priya.shah@helixcommerce.com
+1 415-555-0197
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@helixcommerce.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap & POC asks (languages: EN, ES, FR)

Thanks Priya — great notes. Short answers + proposed next step plan below.

1) Model shortlist (primary / fallback):
   - Primary candidate: Llama-2-Chat-13B (4-bit quantized) — strong English + reasonable Spanish generalization; cost-effective when quantized, good latency on our Dedicated pools.
   - Secondary candidate (better multilingual robustness): Mistral-7B-Instruct (int8 / quant profile) — smaller, lower-cost, good for ES/FR but may lose a few edge-case English intents.
   - Fallback (low-cost): Red-Open-7B-q4f16 (our optimized/open 7B variant) — fastest cold-start and cheapest, use when latency/throughput SLOs are at risk.

2) Fallback routing policy: prefer model routing by request risk/length: short intent classification (<= 128 tokens) -> Red-Open-7B; medium-length contextual routing -> Llama-2-13B; sensitive/high-cost customer path -> Mistral-7B when quality threshold required. Automatic fallback to 7B if p50 latency > 600ms or GPU utilization > 85% for 30s window.

3) Eval assets we need from you:
   - 15k sanitized utterances (you mentioned) + 1k labeled intents for quick seeding (CSV),
   - 150 chat transcripts flagged as hard/failure cases,
   - expected routing taxonomy CSV.

4) Owners & timeline (proposal):
   - Redwood PM/POC lead: Mateo Alvarez (me) — engineering contact, infra & rollout owner.
   - Redwood ML lead: Aditya Rao — model evaluation, prompt templates, acceptance scoring.
   - Helix POC lead: Priya Shah — business acceptance & dataset owner.
   - Helix procurement: Danielle Price — contract/term owner.

Proposed timeline (2-week trial window + prep):
   - Fri 9/24: POC kickoff and dataset handoff
   - Week of 9/27: Model onboarding + baseline eval (3 days)
   - Week of 10/4: Closed test on sanitized traffic + A/B routing (5 days)
   - 10/12: Acceptance review and decision (internal + Helix)

I've attached a preliminary model-grid (model-grid-v1.csv) and a short POC acceptance checklist in the Drive link.

Action items:
   - Priya: share sanitized dataset + routing taxonomy by EOD Thu 9/23 if possible.
   - Danielle: confirm procurement timeline and any required paperwork.
   - Aditya/Monica: I'll loop you both on the kickoff calendar invite.

Regards,
Mateo Alvarez
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
mateo@redwood.com

--

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & POC asks (languages: EN, ES, FR)

Adding a couple of operational details from the Redwood Console/ops side: 

- Observability & metrics: we'll surface token-level cost, per-route latency P50/P95, and per-intent confusion matrix in the console dashboard. We'll set an alert for model quality regression if macro-F1 drops > 0.05 vs baseline.
- Caching: recommend prefix caching for common intents (saves ~20% token cost in trials); we can enable this for the 2-week run.
- Data handling: private deployment option available if you need VPC; for this trial we'll host in our US-hosted Dedicated pool with data retention 30 days (can be shortened).

Procurement note to Danielle: we'll provide a short trial agreement (2 weeks, no charge up to the trial slice) and a simple NDA addendum if needed.

I'll schedule a 30-min kickoff slot on Fri 9/24 - Mateo will send invite.

Monica Patel
Customer Success | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com

Thanks — a few procurement clarifications from my side: 

- Trial agreement: happy with a 2-week pilot no-charge note. I will need an MSA and a short addendum stating data retention terms (30 days) and that trial data will not be used to train public models.
- Billing/contact: if we move past trial we'll need an estimate for monthly committed capacity to compare to our budget. Could you provide a ballpark cost delta between Llama-2-13B quant vs Red-Open-7B fallback per 1M tokens?

Also, we prioritize ES first after EN (about 40% of traffic). If Llama-2 needs additional Spanish prompting or fine-tuning, do you recommend doing prompt engineering only or a small few-shot fine-tune?

Happy to sign the trial agreement today if you send it over.

—Danielle
Danielle Price
Director, Procurement | Helix Commerce
danielle.price@helixcommerce.com

Subject: Re: Discovery recap & POC asks (languages: EN, ES, FR)

Thanks all — short answers and confirmed next steps: 

- Cost ballpark (per 1M tokens, estimates for trial config):
   * Llama-2-Chat-13B (quantized): ~$220 per 1M tokens
   * Mistral-7B-Instruct (int8): ~$95 per 1M tokens
   * Red-Open-7B-q4f16 (fallback): ~$45 per 1M tokens

- Spanish coverage: start with prompt engineering + few-shot examples in the request context. If quality still trails (macro-F1 delta > 0.06), recommend a small targeted fine-tune with 5–10k labeled Spanish examples after the closed test.

Confirmed POC kickoff: Fri 2026-09-24 10:00 AM PT — Mateo to send calendar invite. Deliverables & owners: 
   - Helix: send sanitized dataset + taxonomy (Priya) by EOD Thu 9/23 (if delayed, kickoff still proceeds; dataset can come during the first day).
   - Redwood: model-grid deployment + baseline eval (Aditya), console dashboard + alerts (Monica).
   - Procurement: Danielle to confirm paperwork; Redwood will send trial agreement and data addendum by EOD 9/23.

We will use the Drive folder in the link to share interim evals. Looking forward to kickoff.

Best,
Mateo
